primitives.name: Object State Estimator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The method includes providing a first state module adapted for measuring parameters associated with the object state, communicating the first state module to a wireless receiver, providing electric power to the first module, and switching the first state module in accordance with control signals.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x(t)': 'position vector in meters', 'v(t)': 'velocity vector in m/s', 'a(t)': 'acceleration vector in m/s²', 't': 'time in seconds'}
primitives.assumptions: State parameters are measurable and temporally consistent; communication integrity ensures data fidelity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when sensor data becomes stale or communication link drops below threshold reliability.

layer2.mapping: Maps raw sensor inputs into coherent kinematic state estimates via Kalman filtering and sensor fusion algorithms.
layer2.telemetry: Positional accuracy < 1 cm, update frequency > 30 Hz

primitives.name: Altitude Control Module
primitives.verbatim_quote: US 8,482,612 B2 In some embodiments, the method further includes the step of using object height data provided by an altitude sensor for controlling operation of other sensors.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'h(t)': 'height above ground in meters', 's_h': 'sensor sensitivity in m/V', 'V_h': 'output voltage from altimeter in volts'}
primitives.assumptions: Altitude measurements are accurate and synchronized with other state modules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of altitude signal leads to degraded control of secondary sensors.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a feedback controller that modulates sensor activation based on vertical position.

primitives.name: GPS Orbit Tracker
primitives.verbatim_quote: In some embodiments, the method includes providing data relating to the object state by a global positioning system module (GPS).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'r_{GPS}(t)': 'GPS-derived position vector in meters', 'σ_{GPS}': 'GPS positional uncertainty in meters'}
primitives.assumptions: GPS signals are available and pseudolite network supports high-precision RTK corrections.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal loss or multipath interference causes loss of sub-centimeter accuracy.

layer2.mapping: Provides coarse but precise spatial coordinates used in conjunction with camera and IMU data for full-state estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy better than 5 cm, update rate ≥ 5 Hz
